officialText:
The department, the department of housing preservation and development, or the fire department may stay an order to vacate an eligible basement or cellar residence once an owner has applied for authorization for temporary residence or at any time following the issuance of an authorization for temporary residence.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
